## Editor's Brief

Last 24 hours transformed the US-Iran confrontation into a multi-theater escalation: Washington resumed strikes on Iran, Tehran's IRGC hit US targets in Kuwait, and Ukraine's naval strike on an Iranian vessel added an unexpected front. ## 海军与印太 · 8 items

Overview: Japan's navy and air force crossed long-range strike thresholds this week, while the US Navy placed its largest-ever submarine order and renewed carrier diplomacy in Southeast Asia. These moves signal a regional build-up focused on stand-off precision and undersea deterrence.

- [Japanese destroyer JS Chokai launched a Tomahawk for the first time](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/30/japanese-destroyer-launches-tomahawk-for-the-first-time-in-drill-with-u-s-navy) in a drill with the US Navy. [TWZ says Japan has officially joined the Tomahawk cruise missile club](https://www.twz.com/sea/japan-has-officially-joined-the-tomahawk-cruise-missile-club).
- The JASDF is testing an [air-launched upgraded Type 12 anti-ship missile with a 1,000 km range](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/japan-tests-air-launched-upgraded-type-12-anti-ship-missile/) on an F-2. An F-2 was also spotted carrying a [new large stealth cruise missile](https://www.twz.com/air/japanese-f-2-fighter-appears-with-new-large-stealth-cruise-missile-under-its-wings), and Military Watch assesses [targets across eastern China are now in range](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijgFBVV95cUxNQVVPTC04X21lQ2l2TDN0ZkFYNWZCRGNiSHhFX1pxOHdfZGJJcGVwa2FBSFlwMU5pT3BCUUIybXVaN2lBMnZzTEZNV1Z2UUdkR1hZMmdERTlFTGZqWVVndWM2cEpRTFFoVkdHSWNRVkNzZ3F3ZnJ6dTRtX3RXUmhOTGFZTmhOazc4VVlXZjh3).
- The [US Navy awarded a historic $76.6B contract for 9 Block VI Virginia SSNs and 5 Columbia SSBNs](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/us-navy-awards-historic-76-6b-contract-for-9-block-vi-virginia-ssns-and-5-columbia-ssbns/).
- [USS George Washington arrived in Da Nang](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/30/uss-george-washington-arrives-in-da-nang-first-carrier-visit-to-vietnam-since-2023), the first US carrier visit to Vietnam since 2023.
- [USS Georgia completed its final patrol](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/30/uss-georgia-completes-final-patrol-ahead-of-inactivation-lcs-fort-worth-decommissions) ahead of inactivation, and LCS Fort Worth decommissioned.
- [Hanwha Ocean laid the keel of the final FFX Batch III frigate](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/hanwha-ocean-holds-keel-laying-of-6th-ffx-batch-iii-frigate-for-rok-navy/) for the ROK Navy, while [OKI will supply OQQ-25 towed sonars](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/oki-to-supply-oqq-25-towed-sonars-for-australias-upgraded-mogami-frigates/) for Australia's upgraded Mogami frigates.
